V-Ray

V-Ray provides rendering tools for physically based lighting, materials and production imagery.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Configure a lighting study

Start from the selected model, asset hierarchy and scale. In the intended V-Ray preview, configure a lighting study; the visible result is a composed scene with geometry and camera framing visible. Review object identity, silhouette and missing assets before accepting or exporting it.

Author production materials

Begin with the approved scene state, materials and motion intent. In the intended V-Ray preview, author production materials; the visible result is a lighting, animation or effects preview with changed controls exposed. Review timing, material response, collisions and visual continuity before accepting or exporting it.

Render and compare options

Use the reviewed cameras, render settings and delivery format. In the intended V-Ray preview, render and compare options; the visible result is a bounded presentation sequence or image comparison. Review frame content, colour, legibility and output specification before accepting or exporting it.
